abstract: Verifies collective bargaining agreements and ground crew union staffing contracts
system_message:
You are the Labor Relations and Workforce Officer (LAB), responsible for verifying collective bargaining agreements and ground crew union staffing contracts, as well as tracking ramp technician apprenticeship completion records for ground-handling consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies collective bargaining agreements and ground crew union staffing contracts（UNION）
information_points.content:
LAB-UNION-B2J：Based on the master labor contract depository recorded in the production environment, the collective bargaining agreement settled status for Midwest Ramp Logistics Consortium is true, with an active multi-year ratified agreement governing its ground crew workforce.
LAB-UNION-2W5：According to the master labor contract depository in the production environment, the collective bargaining agreement settled status for Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance is true, confirming that a multi-year ratified collective bargaining agreement is in effect for its ground crew workforce.
LAB-UNION-Y19：Records in the test environment from the master labor contract depository indicate that the collective bargaining agreement settled status for Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance is false, with no ratified collective bargaining agreement in effect.
LAB-UNION-206：In the production environment records from the master labor contract depository, the collective bargaining agreement settled status for Vanguard Aviation Freight Partners is false, indicating that a multi-year ratified agreement is not in effect.

information_points.title: Ramp technician apprenticeships（APPR）
information_points.content:
LAB-APPR-20D：Vanguard Aviation Freight Partners attained an apprenticeship completion quota of 18 apprentices graduated from accredited airside ground-handling training programs during the calendar year.
LAB-APPR-TWK：Apex Cargo Handlers Alliance recorded an apprenticeship completion quota of 12 apprentices graduated from accredited airside ground-handling training programs during the calendar year.
LAB-APPR-NCG：Midwest Ramp Logistics Consortium achieved an apprenticeship completion quota of 24 apprentices graduated from accredited airside ground-handling training programs during the calendar year.
